# R&D Laboratory Equipment

> > R&D Laboratory Equipment is a San Diego-based supplier of used lab equipment, repair services, and compliance certifications for scientific research facilities.

R&D Laboratory Equipment specializes in selling refurbished laboratory instruments, providing equipment repair and calibration, and offering OSHA/NSF-compliant decontamination and certification services. The company serves research institutions and laboratories throughout Southern California and nationwide.

## Product Collections

- [Products](https://rdlaboratoryequipment.com/collections/all): Complete product catalog featuring freezers, refrigerators, and scientific instruments from major brands.
- [Used Lab Equipment](https://rdlaboratoryequipment.com/pages/used-lab-equipment): Used lab equipment including incubators, fume hoods, and centrifuges with cost savings.
- [Used Laboratory Centrifuges](https://rdlaboratoryequipment.com/collections/centrifuges): Used laboratory centrifuges collection offering cost-effective solutions for researchers.
- [Shop Used Laboratory Centrifuges for Sale](https://rdlaboratoryequipment.com/pages/centrifuges): Used centrifuges from Beckman Coulter, Eppendorf, Thermo Fisher, and Sorvall.
- [Used Lab Freezers for Sale](https://rdlaboratoryequipment.com/pages/lab-freezers-refrigerators): Used ultra-low temperature freezers and refrigerators from Thermo Scientific and Eppendorf.
- [Freezers](https://rdlaboratoryequipment.com/collections/freezer): Laboratory freezers for sample and reagent storage at ultra-low temperatures.
- [Used Lab Incubator For Sale](https://rdlaboratoryequipment.com/pages/lab-incubators): Used CO2 and humidity-controlled incubators from Panasonic, Eppendorf, and Thermo Forma.
- [Lab Incubators](https://rdlaboratoryequipment.com/collections/lab-incubators): Used lab incubators collection for chemical and microbiological research applications.
- [Fume Hoods & Biological Safety Cabinets](https://rdlaboratoryequipment.com/collections/fume-hoods-biological-safety-cabinets): Used fume hoods and biosafety cabinets with testing, setup, and nationwide shipping.

## Services & Compliance

- [Lab Equipment Repair in San Diego](https://rdlaboratoryequipment.com/pages/lab-equipment-repair): Lab equipment repair and calibration for HPLC, GC, LC-MS, microscopes, and centrifuges.
- [Lab Equipment Certification San Diego](https://rdlaboratoryequipment.com/pages/certifications-testing): NSF/ISO/cGMP certification and testing services including biosafety cabinets and fume hoods.
- [Lab Equipment Decontamination in San Diego](https://rdlaboratoryequipment.com/pages/decontamination): OSHA/EPA-compliant lab decontamination and equipment cleaning services in San Diego.
- [E-Waste Recycling in San Diego](https://rdlaboratoryequipment.com/pages/ewaste): EPA/OSHA-compliant e-waste recycling, data destruction, and equipment refurbishment services.
